reference.title: Scenario 5: Block image
reference.shortdesc: Consider an image that appears on its own line and is separated from surrounding content.

section.p: Consider an image that appears on its own line and is separated from surrounding content.

entry.codeblock: The following screen shows the Alarm Configuration page. ![Alarm Configuration Screen](images/alarm-config.png) Configure the notification settings before saving the alarm.

Alarm Configuration Screen

section.p: Result: The image appears as a standalone block element. The converter generates a DITA figure containing the image. The image is treated as a distinct piece of content separate from the surrounding paragraphs.
